run.question: Application-gateway server is returning 502 errors in the app-101 namespace. Please investigate.

report.summary: The named subject is not present in this target: there is no namespace app-101 (namespaces present: default, kube-node-lease, kube-public, kube-system, local-path-storage, opspilot-readonly, otel-demo) and no application-gateway workload among the 24 Deployments in the cluster. The only gateway-like component is the Envoy edge proxy Deployment frontend-proxy in namespace otel-demo — a different entity — which is running 1/1 ready with an unchanged pod template (generation 1, created 2026-11-23T14:36:29Z, single ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-844799bcdb). All 22 otel-demo pods are Running and ready with restartCount 0, every Deployment reports available==ready==spec.replicas, and every Service endpoint list is populated (frontend-proxy NodePort 8080 -> 10.244.0.22, frontend -> 10.244.0.20). No NetworkPolicy, Ingress or ResourceQuota objects exist. I could not verify any 502 signal: every Prometheus call (9 attempts) and every Jaeger call (6 attempts) returned SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, and pod-log reads for frontend-proxy, frontend, load-generator and flagd returned no lines in 15:31:06-16:31:06Z (a gap, not evidence of absence), while otel-collector logs were readable and show recurring gRPC connection failures to its own collector address. The fault-injection ConfigMap flagd-config has every flag off and no write since install. No 502 rate, failing span or failing operation was observed, so no root cause can be named. Runbook application-gateway-troubleshooting was fetched and its steps attempted: Step 1 (gateway pod status) — no application-gateway pod exists in app-101; the related frontend-proxy pod is running/ready. Step 2 (gateway error logs) — log reads for frontend-proxy returned no lines in the window, so no error lines could be examined. Step 3 (upstream services) — all otel-demo workloads and frontend/frontend-proxy endpoints are healthy. Step 4 (config check via exec 'appg -t') — could not be carried out, no exec/in-container command tool is configured; the Deployment spec was read instead and is unchanged. Step 5 (service endpoints) — all 26 Endpoints objects in otel-demo have addresses and none are not-ready.

claims.text: No namespace named app-101 exists in this cluster; the namespaces returned are default, kube-node-lease, kube-public, kube-system, local-path-storage, opspilot-readonly and otel-demo.
A pods query scoped to namespace app-101 returned zero objects (total_items_processed 0), so no pod exists in that namespace at query time.

None of the 24 Deployments in the cluster (all namespaces) is named application-gateway; the otel-demo set is ad, cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, jaeger, kube-state-metrics, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, product-catalog, prometheus, prometheus-readonly-proxy, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart, plus coredns and metrics-server in kube-system and local-path-provisioner in local-path-storage.

Every one of those 24 Deployments reports readyReplicas and availableReplicas equal to spec.replicas with an Available=True (MinimumReplicasAvailable) condition, including frontend-proxy in otel-demo (1/1).

All 22 pods in namespace otel-demo are phase Running, every container reports ready=true with restartCount 0 and no lastState termination, and they were created between 2026-11-23T14:36:29Z and 2026-11-23T14:38:04Z; the gateway-like pod frontend-proxy-844799bcdb-q7f5n is owned by ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-844799bcdb.

The frontend-proxy Deployment is generation 1, created 2026-11-23T14:36:29Z and last written only by manager helm (Apply) at that time, and has exactly one ReplicaSet, frontend-proxy-844799bcdb, created 2026-11-23T14:36:31Z with replicas 1 and ready 1; there is no rollout and no sibling ReplicaSet.

The frontend-proxy container's env sets FRONTEND_HOST=frontend / FRONTEND_PORT=8080 (its proxy upstream) and FLAGD_HOST=flagd / FLAGD_PORT=8013, with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-frontend-proxy.

All Services have populated endpoints: frontend-proxy (NodePort, port 8080) has address 10.244.0.22 and frontend (ClusterIP, port 8080) has address 10.244.0.20, and none of the 26 Endpoints objects in otel-demo shows a not-ready address.
There are no NetworkPolicy objects, no Ingress objects and no ResourceQuota objects in the cluster, so no network-policy, ingress-routing or quota object was present to block or reject traffic.

Every flag in the flagd-config ConfigMap (demo.flagd.json) has defaultVariant "off": productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, adManualGc, adHighCpu, adFailure, kafkaQueueProblems (on=100/off=0), cartFailure, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage (on=100/off=0) and imageSlowLoad (off=0) are all off in the configuration now in effect.

The flagd-config ConfigMap was created and last written at 2026-11-23T14:36:29Z by manager helm with no later write, and the flagd Deployment is generation 1, created 2026-11-23T14:36:29Z, mounting that ConfigMap at /etc/flagd and starting flagd with --uri file:./etc/flagd/demo.flagd.json.

The otel-collector pod otel-collector-69c9f9649-vdpcn does produce logs and repeatedly logs gRPC transport failures toward its own collector address: "addrConn.createTransport failed to connect to {Addr: \"10.96.73.1:4318\", ServerName: \"otel-collector:4318\"}. Err: connection error: ... http2: frame too large, note that the frame header looked like an HTTP/1.1 header", roughly every 1.5-2 minutes from 2026-11-23T15:41:37Z through 2026-11-23T16:30:49Z, plus "failed to upload metrics: reader collect and export timeout" at 2026-11-23T16:30:58Z.
The single node opspilot-m1-control-plane is Ready=True and reports no MemoryPressure, DiskPressure or PIDPressure, so node-level resource exhaustion is not visible in node conditions.

The otel-demo Prometheus rules define only CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh (checkout PlaceOrder server-span error ratio > 0.5 for 2m) plus the self-monitoring OpsPilotAgentAbsent and OpsPilotModelCallsFailing alerts; there is no Application-Gateway or generic 502 alerting rule in that rule file, and the ConfigMap's alerts field is "{}".

Rejected as cause: a crash, restart or eviction of the gateway/upstream pods. All 22 otel-demo pods are Running and ready with restartCount 0 and no lastState termination reason such as OOMKilled, and every Deployment has all replicas ready.

Rejected as cause: an active flagd fault-injection setting. Every fault flag in flagd-config has defaultVariant "off" and the ConfigMap has had no write since the 14:36:29Z install, so no client-side injected failure (product-catalog, cart, ad, payment, recommendation, image load or load flood) is switched on.

Rejected as cause: missing Service endpoints or a selector mismatch between the proxy and its upstream. All 26 otel-demo Endpoints objects have addresses and no not-ready addresses, and the Service selectors resolve to pods: frontend-proxy (opentelemetry.io/name=frontend-proxy) to 10.244.0.22 and frontend (opentelemetry.io/name=frontend) to 10.244.0.20.

Object-level evidence does not show a failing gateway: the frontend-proxy Deployment is 1/1 ready with an unchanged pod template (generation 1, single ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-844799bcdb) and its pod frontend-proxy-844799bcdb-q7f5n has zero restarts.

The reported symptom may belong to a different environment or naming scheme than this target: the cluster has no app-101 namespace and no application-gateway workload, and its only edge/gateway component is the Envoy Deployment frontend-proxy in otel-demo. Whether 502s occur there could not be tested because the metric and trace backends were unreachable in this Run.

A candidate cause that remains untested rather than supported: requests through frontend-proxy could be answered 502 if its upstream frontend returned connection failures, but no such failure was observed — the frontend pod is ready with zero restarts and frontend's endpoint address 10.244.0.20 is present — and no error-rate or error-span evidence could be read.

The otel-collector's recurring gRPC failures to otel-collector:4318 (HTTP/1.1 preface vs gRPC) and its 'failed to upload metrics' timeout are a plausible cause of incomplete telemetry in this pipeline; its own config (ConfigMap otel-collector, key relay) sends metrics to prometheus:9090/api/v1/otlp and traces to jaeger-collector:4317, so if self-telemetry export at otel-collector:4318 is failing this is not the pipeline that populates Prometheus. Nothing observed ties these failures causally to 502 responses, so this remains an unverified hypothesis about observability rather than about the gateway.

Re-run this investigation once the Prometheus and Jaeger endpoints for target m0-otel-20260909 are reachable, and first query traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy",status_code=~"STATUS_CODE_ERROR.*"} together with http_server_request_duration_seconds_count for frontend-proxy to establish whether 5xx responses exist and when they started, then compare with frontend's own server spans.

Confirm with the requester which cluster and namespace the report refers to; if it is this target, the subject to inspect is the frontend-proxy Deployment/Envoy in otel-demo (NodePort 8080), and enabling Envoy access logging or upstream-cluster statistics would make 502 diagnoses observable.

gaps: Prometheus was unreachable for the whole Run: execute_prometheus_instant_query, metrics_range_query, get_metric_names, get_label_values, get_all_labels, get_prometheus_target and list_prometheus_rules all returned status error / SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE across 9 attempts, so no 502 rate, error time series, scrape target health or firing-alert state could be read — this is unknown, not zero.

Jaeger was unreachable for the whole Run: traces_search, traces_search_by_tags, traces_list_services and traces_list_operations all returned status error / SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE across 6 attempts, so no error span, span status or call edge of frontend-proxy or any upstream could be examined.

Pod-log reads returned no lines (status no_data, bytes_read 0) for frontend-proxy-844799bcdb-q7f5n, frontend-6c9bc688bf-ll8s7, load-generator-5ff476786d-zp9gc and flagd-d6485586b-h9n2s over the sampled window 2026-11-23T15:31:06Z-16:31:06Z, with no previous container instance available; those queries matched nothing, so runtime error lines for the gateway and its upstream are unknown rather than absent. Only otel-collector logs were readable.

An all-namespace events query returned status no_data with 0 items, and a pods query filtered to non-Running phases returned status no_data with 0 matches, so event-based evidence (Evicted, OOMKilled, Unhealthy, kill signals) and any non-Running pod are unavailable from this Run; object queries also reflect only the state at query time, not the earlier part of the window.
No change-history integration is configured, so no record exists of who or what may have changed configuration.

Namespace app-101 and a workload named application-gateway do not exist in this target, so the reported subject could not be inspected at all; whether the requester meant frontend-proxy in otel-demo is unconfirmed.
The runbook's Step 4 (exec 'appg -t' inside the gateway pod) could not be carried out because no exec/in-container command tool is configured; only the Deployment spec and logs were examined.
next_steps: Verify with the requester which cluster/namespace 'app-101' and 'application-gateway' refer to, since neither exists in this target.

Once Prometheus access is restored, quantify frontend-proxy 5xx responses over time (increase of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy",status_code=~"STATUS_CODE_ERROR.*"} and http_server_request_duration_seconds_count by status) and compare with the pre-incident baseline.
Once Jaeger access is restored, inspect frontend-proxy traces for spans whose upstream call to frontend failed, using parent references to establish the call edge.
Check the Prometheus/prometheus-readonly-proxy and jaeger pods' own readiness and logs directly if the observability endpoints keep returning SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.

content.alerting_rules_yml:
groups:
- name: opspilot-lab
  rules:
  - alert: CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of checkout PlaceOrder server
        spans ended in error over the last 5 minutes.'
      summary: checkout PlaceOrder error ratio above 50%
    expr: |
      label_replace(label_replace(
        (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m])))
        /
        (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}[5m])))
      , "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.*)"), "service", "$1", "service_name", "(.*)")
      > 0.5
    for: 2m
    labels:
      cluster: opspilot-m1
      opspilot_integration_id: m0-otel-20260909
      severity: critical
- name: opspilot-self
  rules:
  - alert: OpsPilotAgentAbsent
    annotations:
      description: role {{ $labels.role }} ({{ $labels.instance }}) has not answered
        /metrics for 2 minutes.
      summary: an OpsPilot health listener is down or the worker is not scraped
    expr: up{job="opspilot"} == 0 or absent(up{job="opspilot",role="worker"})
    for: 2m
    labels:
      opspilot_self: "true"
      severity: critical
  - alert: OpsPilotModelCallsFailing
    annotations:
      description: '{{ $value }} consecutive model calls failed on {{ $labels.instance
        }}.'
      summary: OpsPilot model calls are failing
    expr: opspilot_model_consecutive_failures >= 2
    for: 1m
    labels:
      opspilot_self: "true"
      severity: critical

content.relay:
connectors:
  spanmetrics: {}
exporters:
  debug: {}
  opensearch:
    http:
      endpoint: http://opensearch:9200
      tls:
        insecure: true
    logs_index: otel
  otlp:
    endpoint: jaeger-collector:4317
    tls:
      insecure: true
  otlphttp/prometheus:
    auth:
      [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL] basicauth/prometheus
    endpoint: http://prometheus:9090/api/v1/otlp
    tls:
      insecure: true
extensions:
  basicauth/prometheus:
    client_auth:
      [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL] [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL]
      username: collector
  health_check:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:13133
processors:
  batch: {}
  k8sattributes:
    extract:
      metadata:
      - k8s.namespace.name
      - k8s.deployment.name
      - k8s.statefulset.name
      - k8s.daemonset.name
      - k8s.cronjob.name
      - k8s.job.name
      - k8s.node.name
      - k8s.pod.name
      - k8s.pod.uid
      - k8s.pod.start_time
    passthrough: false
    pod_association:
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.ip
    - sources:
      - from: resource_attribute
        name: k8s.pod.uid
    - sources:
      - from: connection
  memory_limiter:
    check_interval: 5s
    limit_percentage: 80
    spike_limit_percentage: 25
  resource:
    attributes:
    - action: insert
      from_attribute: k8s.pod.uid
      key: service.instance.id
  transform:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
    - context: span
      statements:
      - replace_pattern(name, "\\?.*", "")
      - replace_match(name, "GET /api/products/*", "GET /api/products/{productId}")
receivers:
  httpcheck/frontend-proxy:
    targets:
    - endpoint: http://frontend-proxy:8080
  jaeger:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14250
      thrift_compact:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:6831
      thrift_http:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:14268
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4317
      http:
        cors:
          allowed_origins:
          - http://*
          - https://*
        endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:4318
  prometheus:
    config:
      scrape_configs:
      - job_name: opentelemetry-collector
        scrape_interval: 10s
        static_configs:
        - targets:
          - ${env:MY_POD_IP}:8888
  redis:
    collection_interval: 10s
    endpoint: valkey-cart:6379
  zipkin:
    endpoint: ${env:MY_POD_IP}:9411
service:
  extensions:
  - health_check
  - basicauth/prometheus
  pipelines:
    logs:
      exporters:
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
    metrics:
      exporters:
      - otlphttp/prometheus
      - debug
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - batch
      receivers:
      - httpcheck/frontend-proxy
      - redis
      - otlp
      - spanmetrics
    traces:
      exporters:
      - otlp
      - debug
      - spanmetrics
      processors:
      - k8sattributes
      - memory_limiter
      - resource
      - transform
      - batch
      receivers:
      - otlp
      - jaeger
      - zipkin
  telemetry:
    metrics:
      level: detailed
      readers:
      - periodic:
          exporter:
            otlp:
              endpoint: otel-collector:4318
              protocol: grpc
          interval: 10000
          timeout: 5000
